intro: This zone follows the main road west from Deccan through Shivajinagar, Erandwane, Kothrud and Karve Nagar to Warje, with Model Colony tucked inside Shivajinagar. It is the older, settled side of west Pune. Deccan Gymkhana mixes bungalows and apartment blocks with shops, cafés and bookshops, Erandwane takes in Prabhat Road and keeps old bungalows on tree-lined lanes, and Model Colony was planned in the mid-twentieth century with wide internal roads. Kothrud, below the Vetal Tekdi hills, has seen many older buildings redeveloped into taller blocks, while Warje and its Malwadi side filled with large housing complexes after 2000.

For parents, the zone's big advantage is the metro. The Aqua Line runs from Vanaz through Anand Nagar and Paud Phata to Deccan Gymkhana and on to District Court, where it meets the Purple Line from Pimpri-Chinchwad, and Shivajinagar also has suburban trains towards Lonavala. A tutor living almost anywhere along those two lines can reach the heart of the zone with one change at most. The gaps are Karve Nagar and Warje, which have no station, so families there usually look for a tutor from Kothrud, Erandwane or Warje itself who comes by two-wheeler.

NXTutors builds a list for this zone by looking first at tutors who live in it, then at those who already travel here from elsewhere in Pune, then at the wider city, and finally at online tutors across India. You get two or three who fit your child's class, board and timetable, with each fee visible before you book. The first lesson is a free demo. Because Paud Road and the road into Deccan slow down every evening, many families here settle on a slot before the rush or a weekend morning. If the tutor later stops suiting your child, changing costs nothing.
faqs: Which areas are in the Kothrud, Karve Nagar & Deccan zone?

Kothrud, Karve Nagar, Erandwane, Deccan Gymkhana, Shivajinagar, Model Colony and Warje. It runs along the west bank of the Mutha, from the busy streets of Deccan out to Warje near the highway bypass, and includes older bungalow lanes as well as large newer housing complexes.
Can a tutor from Pimpri-Chinchwad reach Kothrud by metro?

Yes, with one change. The Purple Line runs from PCMC Bhavan to District Court, where it meets the Aqua Line; from there the Aqua Line continues west through Deccan Gymkhana to Paud Phata, Anand Nagar and Vanaz in Kothrud. The last stretch to your building is usually a walk or a short auto ride.
How do tutors reach Karve Nagar and Warje without a metro station?

Mostly by two-wheeler, from Kothrud, Erandwane or Warje itself. Vanaz on the Aqua Line is the closest metro stop for Warje, and city buses link Karve Nagar with Deccan and Swargate. Warje homes are largely in gated complexes, so the tutor's name should go on the visitor list first.
Do NXTutors tutors in Kothrud charge a fixed rate?

No. Each tutor sets their own fee, and it is shown on your shortlist before the demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: The western edge of Pune, along the Katraj–Dehu Road bypass, is covered by this zone: Aundh, Baner, Balewadi, Pashan, Sus and Bavdhan. Aundh has apartment buildings, gated societies, independent houses and villas along Ganeshkhind Road up to the bridge over the Mula. Baner is now a mix of large offices and high-rise complexes below Baner Hill, and Balewadi, next to Mahalunge, is mostly high-rise towers around its High Street and a large sports complex. Pashan keeps apartment buildings beside government and research campuses, Sus lies in a valley between hills, and Bavdhan combines societies with older independent houses near Chandani Chowk.

Home tutoring here is shaped by roads, not rail. No metro station in the zone was carrying passengers at the time of the research: Line 3 from Hinjewadi towards Shivajinagar is under construction with stations planned in Balewadi, Baner and Aundh, and the Aqua Line's extension towards Chandani Chowk is also under construction. So most tutors ride in by two-wheeler, and the shorter that ride, the steadier the weekly slot. A family in Sus is usually well served by someone from Pashan, Baner or Bavdhan, and a family in Balewadi with a tutor from Baner, Wakad or Aundh.

That is why the NXTutors shortlist for this zone leans on distance. It lists tutors who live in the zone first, then those who already travel here, then the rest of Pune, then online tutors across India for subjects without a local match. You see two or three profiles with their fees, choose one, and the first class is a free demo at home or online. Baner Road and Ganeshkhind Road fill up as offices close, so later-evening or weekend lessons are common. Should the tutor stop being the right fit, switching to another one on your list is free.
faqs: Is there a working metro station in Aundh, Baner or Balewadi?

Not at the time of our research. Metro Line 3, from Maan near Hinjewadi towards Shivajinagar, is under construction with stations planned at Balewadi High Street, Balewadi Phata, Baner Gaon, Baner Pashan Link Road and Aundh. Until the line opens, tutors reach the zone by road, most often by two-wheeler from a neighbouring suburb.
Where do tutors for a home in Sus usually come from?

Mostly from Pashan, Baner, Bavdhan or Balewadi. Sus is reached along the Pashan–Sus Road, with the highway bypass close by, and has no metro station. Its gated societies usually want the tutor's details before the first class, so share them a day ahead to avoid a wait at the gate.
Is Chandani Chowk a problem for lessons in Bavdhan?

It can be at peak hours. Several major roads meet at Chandani Chowk, on Bavdhan's edge, and the junction slows down in the office rush. Tutors from Kothrud or Pashan often come by two-wheeler; the nearest working metro stop is Vanaz, from where an auto covers the rest.
How many tutors does NXTutors suggest for a Baner request?

Two or three, chosen for your child's class, board, subjects, timing and budget, with those living nearest Baner listed first. Each profile shows the tutor's fee before booking. You pick one for a free demo lesson and decide afterwards, and moving to another tutor later carries no charge.

intro: This zone joins the IT suburbs with the older industrial city of Pimpri-Chinchwad. Hinjewadi, with Marunji and Maan beside it, grew around a large IT park built in three phases, ringed by apartment townships. Wakad next door is mostly gated societies, and Pimple Saudagar and Pimple Nilakh, across the Mula from Baner and Aundh, are society neighbourhoods popular with young families. Pimpri has factories, markets and homes close together, Chinchwad on the Pavana river runs from its village core to large townships, and Nigdi holds the numbered Pradhikaran sectors of independent houses, row houses and apartment complexes.

The zone splits into two halves for a tutor. The older, northern half is on rails: the Purple Line starts at PCMC Bhavan in Pimpri and runs south to Shivajinagar and Swargate, and suburban trains on the Pune–Lonavala line stop at Pimpri, Chinchwad and Akurdi. An extension of the Purple Line through Chinchwad and Akurdi to Nigdi is under construction. The IT half has no working metro yet, as Line 3 through Hinjewadi and Wakad Chowk is still under construction, so tutors come by road through some of the busiest office traffic in Pune. Families in Hinjewadi and Wakad usually find a tutor from their own township easier to keep.

NXTutors handles that split by starting every list with tutors who live in this zone, then those who travel to it, then the rest of Pune, then online tutors. For a Hinjewadi or Wakad family, online lessons on the heaviest office days often keep the week intact. You receive two or three matched tutors, can compare their fees before anything is booked, and the first class with your chosen tutor is a free demo. Families in the Nigdi sectors often find a tutor who can walk or ride over. If the arrangement stops working, changing tutor is free.
faqs: Which metro stations serve Pimpri and Chinchwad today?

PCMC Bhavan and the next station south on the Purple Line serve Pimpri, and both have been open since March 2022. Chinchwad has no working metro station yet; the extension through Chinchwad, Akurdi, Nigdi and Bhakti Shakti is under construction. Meanwhile, Chinchwad railway station has suburban trains on the Pune–Lonavala line.
What are homes in the Nigdi Pradhikaran sectors like?

Pradhikaran is a planned area laid out in numbered sectors, with independent houses, row houses and apartment complexes. In a house or row house the tutor comes straight to the door; societies keep a gate register. Akurdi railway station, in Sector 26, has suburban trains, and Bhakti Shakti has a major bus terminal.
What time suits a home lesson in Hinjewadi?

Away from office hours. Roads around the IT park are very busy in the morning and evening peaks, so tutors generally prefer an early-evening or weekend slot timed against the rush. Most tutors for Hinjewadi homes come from Wakad, Maan or nearby townships, and township gates need a visitor entry.
Can we mix home and online lessons with the same tutor?

Yes. Many families in this zone keep one home visit a week and move another lesson online on busy office days, with the same tutor. The first class is a free demo in whichever format you prefer, each tutor's fee is shown up front, and changing tutor later is free.

intro: This eastern zone runs out along Nagar Road, the Pune to Ahmednagar road, from Yerawada through Kalyani Nagar, Viman Nagar and Vadgaon Sheri to Kharadi and Wagholi. Yerawada is densely built, with homes in pockets between office parks and other large campuses, and a mix of independent houses, older builder floors and newer apartment buildings. Kalyani Nagar, on the river opposite Koregaon Park, mixes societies and villas with offices and restaurants. Viman Nagar, once called Dunkirk Lines, sits just south of the airport, Vadgaon Sheri's central part is known as New Kalyani Nagar, and Kharadi and Wagholi are largely apartment towers and gated societies.

For home tuition the zone divides at Ramwadi. Up to that point the Aqua Line gives a tutor from Vanaz, Deccan or Shivajinagar a direct ride, with stations at Yerwada, Kalyani Nagar and Ramwadi beside Viman Nagar. Beyond it, Kharadi and Wagholi have no station; an extension towards Wagholi is planned but not built, so tutors come by two-wheeler, bus or auto along Nagar Road, which is heavy at the start and end of the office day. Large societies in Kharadi may limit visitor parking. The practical answer is a tutor from Kharadi, Wagholi or Viman Nagar for the far end, and a metro traveller for the rest.

An NXTutors request from this zone is matched first with tutors who live here, then with those who already come in from other parts of Pune, then with the wider city, and after that with online tutors from anywhere in India, which suits families wanting an IB, IGCSE or senior science specialist. You get two or three tutors with the fee for each shown in advance. Your first class is a free demo, at home or online, and you choose only after it. Changing to another tutor later, whether for a new subject or a board year, is also free.
faqs: Which Aqua Line stations are in this zone?

Yerwada, Kalyani Nagar and Ramwadi. The Ramwadi section, including Kalyani Nagar, opened in March 2024, and Yerwada station followed in August 2024. Ramwadi, the eastern terminus, stands on Nagar Road beside Viman Nagar and also suits Vadgaon Sheri, with an auto or a walk for the last part.
How do tutors get to Kharadi and Wagholi?

By road for now. Neither has a metro station; the nearest is Ramwadi on the Aqua Line, and the extension towards Wagholi has not been built. Tutors come by two-wheeler, bus or auto along Nagar Road, so give a clear block number and sort out the gate pass before the first visit.
Is Yerawada easy for a tutor to reach from Deccan?

Yes. Yerwada station on the Aqua Line lies between Bund Garden and Kalyani Nagar, so a tutor from Deccan or Shivajinagar can ride straight there and walk or take an auto into the lane. Junctions around the river bridges are busy at office times, which matters for evening lessons.
What should we look for in the free demo class?

Whether the tutor explains a topic your child finds hard in a way they follow, and whether they know how your board marks answers. The demo is free, with the tutor you pick from two or three matched profiles. If it is not right, the next tutor can take a demo too.

intro: South of the Mula-Mutha, grouped around the former troop lines of the cantonment, this zone covers Koregaon Park, Camp, Wanowrie and Salunke Vihar. Koregaon Park's leafy lanes still hold British-era bungalows beside newer premium apartment buildings, with North Main Road and South Main Road and numbered lanes between them. Camp, run by its cantonment board rather than the municipal corporation, mixes apartments, older villas and builder floors with army areas and busy shopping streets. Wanowrie is settled housing towards Hadapsar, with older pockets and apartment complexes, and Salunke Vihar, between Wanowrie, Kondhwa and NIBM Road, is a quieter mix of independent homes and societies, including the Sainik Vihar pocket.

The northern half of the zone is easy for a tutor to reach. Bund Garden station on the Aqua Line serves Koregaon Park, the Pune Railway Station metro stop and Pune Junction serve Camp, and a bridge joins Koregaon Park to Kalyani Nagar across the river. The southern half is different: Wanowrie and Salunke Vihar have no station close by, so tutors come by two-wheeler, bus or auto, with Swargate on the Purple Line as the nearest metro. In Camp's narrow lanes and near its shopping streets parking is tight. Families near army areas should check the entry rules for a visiting tutor before booking.

On NXTutors, a family in this zone sees tutors living here first, followed by those who travel in from nearby parts of Pune, then the rest of the city, then online tutors across India. For IB or IGCSE subjects, a home tutor for most of the week plus an online specialist is a common pattern. Two or three matched tutors come back to you with fees listed before anything is fixed, and the first class is a free demo. If the chosen tutor stops fitting your child's needs, you can move to another one on the list, and the switch costs you nothing.
faqs: Why is Camp run differently from the rest of Pune?

Camp is the everyday name for the Pune Cantonment, set up in 1817 for troops, and a cantonment board, not the municipal corporation, governs it. For home tuition this matters mainly near army areas, where visitors may need a pass, so ask what a tutor requires before you book the demo.
Which metro station is closest to Koregaon Park?

Bund Garden on the Aqua Line, open since March 2024, with Yerwada station across the river as an alternative. Tutors usually finish by auto into the numbered lanes. Pune Junction railway station is also nearby, which helps tutors arriving by suburban train from Pimpri-Chinchwad or Lonavala.
How do tutors travel to Salunke Vihar?

Usually on a two-wheeler, or by bus or auto; the closest metro is Swargate, the Purple Line terminus. Salunke Vihar Road connects the pocket with Wanowrie and Camp to the north and with Kondhwa and NIBM Road to the south, and its junctions slow down on weekday evenings.
What does a home tutor in Koregaon Park cost?

It depends on the tutor, who sets the fee, and on the class and subject. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: Five neighbourhoods make up the south-east zone: Hadapsar, Magarpatta, Kondhwa, Undri and the NIBM Road belt. Hadapsar, on Solapur Road, runs from the old village and Gadital area to apartment societies and large gated townships, with Fursungi, Manjri and Mundhwa around it. Magarpatta, inside Hadapsar, is a planned township of apartment clusters and a few villa clusters, with offices, shops and a large central park. Kondhwa, made up of Kondhwa Budruk and Kondhwa Khurd, spans older cooperative societies, mid-rise apartments from the 2000s and high-rise townships. NIBM Road is mostly societies and gated communities along a busy main road, and Undri beyond it is a quieter area of mid-segment societies.

No metro line reaches this zone, and that decides most choices about tutoring. Local trains towards Daund stop at Hadapsar, buses leave from Gadital, and for Kondhwa and NIBM Road the nearest metro is Swargate, several neighbourhoods away. In practice almost every tutor rides a two-wheeler or takes a bus or auto, so the most reliable match is a tutor who already lives somewhere in this south-east belt. Township entry is controlled, often down to the cluster and tower, and NIBM Road carries heavy school and office traffic. Solapur Road and the bypass roads towards Kharadi are slow at office times too, so choose a start time when those roads have eased.

NXTutors starts its search for a south-east Pune home inside the zone, then adds tutors who travel here, then the rest of Pune, and then online tutors anywhere in India for specialist or advanced subjects. You are sent two or three tutors who match your child's class, board, subjects and timing, with each fee shown before you book. The first class is a free demo, and you choose afterwards. Families in Magarpatta and the larger townships often keep lessons just after the school rush. If the tutor later stops working out, switching to someone else is free.
faqs: Is there a metro near Hadapsar or Kondhwa?

No. No metro line runs through the zone yet. For Kondhwa and NIBM Road the closest metro station is Swargate, and Hadapsar has a railway station with local trains to Daund. Because nearly every tutor comes by road, a tutor who lives nearby keeps the timetable far steadier.
What should we tell the gate for a tutor visiting Magarpatta?

The tutor's name, plus your cluster, tower and flat number, before the first visit. Magarpatta is a gated township with controlled entry, and telling the tutor which cluster and tower to head for avoids delays. Office traffic at the township gates peaks around shift changes, so avoid those hours.
Where do tutors for Undri homes usually come from?

Largely from neighbouring Kondhwa, the NIBM Road belt or Hadapsar, on two-wheelers or by bus and auto. Undri is reached by NIBM Road, Kondhwa Road and the Katraj to Hadapsar bypass. Send clear directions to the society gate and your tower, because many societies here are spread over a large plot.
Can we change tutor if the first one does not suit our child?

Yes, and it is free. After the demo you can ask for the next tutor on your shortlist to take a demo of their own, and you can switch again later in the year. Each new tutor's fee is shown before you agree, so you always know the cost first.

intro: South Pune's zone runs from Swargate towards the hills and takes in Katraj, Bibwewadi, Dhankawadi and the long string of neighbourhoods along Sinhagad Road. Katraj, below the ghat on the Satara highway, has an old lake from the Peshwa period and is ringed by independent houses, cooperative societies and newer apartment complexes. Bibwewadi, near Market Yard, has independent homes, builder floors and apartment buildings side by side. Dhankawadi, which joined the city in 1995, has houses, apartment complexes and a few gated communities. Sinhagad Road covers Vitthalwadi, Anand Nagar, Hingne Khurd, Vadgaon Budruk and Dhayari, where former farmland is now mostly apartment complexes.

For a tutor, the metro stops at the zone's edge. The Purple Line terminates underground at Swargate. An underground extension south to Katraj is planned, with Bibwewadi among its stops, but no train runs on it yet. So a tutor who comes by metro gets off at Swargate and finishes by bus or auto, while most others ride in by two-wheeler. On Sinhagad Road a long flyover now lifts through traffic above the most crowded stretch. Because the homes here are spread along long roads, naming your neighbourhood as well as the road helps a new tutor more than anything else.

When a south Pune family asks NXTutors for help, tutors who live in this zone are listed first, then those who travel here from other parts of the city, then the rest of Pune, and then online tutors across India. You receive two or three matched profiles, each with the tutor's own fee visible, and the first class with the one you choose is a free demo. In an independent house the tutor simply rings at the door, which makes early slots easy to keep. If you want a different tutor later, for a board year or a new subject, the change is free.
faqs: Does the metro reach Katraj yet?

Not yet. Metro trains stop at Swargate, the Purple Line terminus, and the underground extension planned to Katraj, with stops such as Padmavati and Balaji Nagar on the way, has no services yet. A tutor travelling by metro therefore changes at Swargate to a bus or auto for the rest of the trip.
Which neighbourhoods count as Sinhagad Road?

The name covers a long line of residential areas along the road from near Sarasbaug towards Sinhagad fort, such as Vitthalwadi, Hingne Khurd, Vadgaon Budruk and, further out, Dhayari. When you request a tutor, name your neighbourhood too, because the road alone does not tell a tutor how far they must travel.
What is housing like in Bibwewadi for a visiting tutor?

A mix of independent houses, builder floors and apartment buildings, with a few gated communities; flats of one to three bedrooms are typical. In houses and builder floors the tutor usually comes straight up, while apartment buildings may keep a visitor book. Satara Road is heavy at school and office hours.
How does NXTutors choose which tutors to show us?

By fit and distance. Tutors are matched to your child's class, board, subjects, times and budget, then ordered with those living nearest first, then those who travel to your area, then the wider city, then online. You see two or three, each with a fee, and the demo is free.
